queries_run: Semiconductors shortage OR oversupply structural OR cyclical 2026 2027
Semiconductors supply discipline new capacity timeline
ALAB Astera Labs product demand durability structural 2026

findings.claim: Gartner 2026年7月存貨預測：2Q26 全球半導體存貨指標(GIISST)降8.5%進入中度短缺，受AI半導體需求驅動，預期此趨勢延續至2027年。
findings.excerpt: In 2Q26, the GIISST fell 8.5% into moderate shortage, driven by strong AI semiconductor demand. This trend is expected to persist through 2027

findings.claim: TrendForce：2026年NAND供給短缺4-5%，2027下半年供給位元成長將超過需求成長（二手轉載）。
findings.source: TrendForce via itiger: NAND Flash Supply Shortage Expected to Ease in Second Half of 2027
findings.excerpt: supply will fall short of demand by 4-5% in 2026, but by the second half of 2027, the growth in supply bits will outpace demand growth.

findings.claim: Wolfe Research分析師Chris Caso認為半導體供過於求最早在2028年之前幾無可能（受新晶圓廠物理限制）。
findings.source: 247WallSt: Top Chip Analyst: Semiconductor Oversupply Is Nearly Impossible Before 2028

findings.claim: Micron執行長在9月30日財報會議表示記憶體供需於FY2027、FY2028可能進一步趨緊；下一波供給(Micron愛達荷/日本、SK hynix清州)多要到2028下半年後才放量。
ASML(2026年7月)：產能實質上賣到2027，訂單簿延伸至2028，指引今年約成長35%。
findings.source: Quilter: ASML beat and raise reinforces strength of semiconductor demand

findings.claim: SEMI：300mm晶圓月產能至2028年底達1110萬片，年複合成長7%；先進製程(7nm以下)CAGR 14%。
findings.source: The Machine Maker: SEMI Projects 69% Growth in Advanced Semiconductor Capacity by 2028 Driven by AI Demand

findings.claim: ALAB Q1 2026營收3.084億美元、年增93%；PCIe Gen 6約占近季營收三分之一且ASP高於前代；第三方稱Q2 2026營收年增104%至3.924億美元；風險含自研客戶晶片、多季客戶ramp執行風險。
findings.source: TIKR: Astera Labs Stock Is Up 227% in One Year

supply_demand_durability.note: 摘要僅部分含可逐字引文，其餘excerpt填null；as_of多為月份近似日。無來源稱此為永久結構性短缺，皆為AI需求驅動＋新產能2028後放量的時程描述。
